title: The Export dialog, on the Release design

steps.caption: Open Export: Stereo WAV, every track in the mix, one file in the Downloads row
Choose Stems (ZIP): all 50 tracks on, and a note says they come as 4 ZIPs, each under 2 GiB
Ctrl/⌘-click picks tracks without flipping them; the ruler offers On, Off and Only these
Export: ZIP 1 is downloaded, ZIP 2 of 4 prints behind the white playhead
Cancel keeps the finished ZIP and offers Resume from ZIP 2
A failure names the ZIP and what to do, and offers Resume from it
All ZIPs are in the downloads: the sleeve, in the tracks' own colours
A stereo mix finishes the same way, with the mix's own readouts
